# FIN6 RC (16 nodes, two 8-node groups, segment 8, limit 7000 s per group): REHEARSAL C: the remaining kill rows (no-EPLB second victims, every online row).
# Generated by gen_finals_v6.py (review/FINALS_PLAN.md v6 + PRE-REG; schedule in review/FINALS_SCHEDULE_v6.md).
# Wheel build-freeze-1117f7e0e7 (= v5-final 1117f7e0e7), no overlay. One pinned tactic table per mode from the
# rehearsal's tuning passes (FT_COST_E2E_SEED). 300 s windows (COST_MAX_WAVES=40 lifts the 20-wave cap).
# Kill victims rotate per repeat: no-EPLB ranks 5/22, nodes 1/5; online ranks 13/29, nodes 3/7 (KF_VICTIM_*).
# G0: no-EPLB rank5pf, rank0, deadline (22/5, late 26) (2 + 29) + rank5@32 (2 + 11.5) + online rank5, node1, twokill (2 + 36) = ~83
# G8: online stop, rank5pf, rank5upd, rank0, deadline (29/7, late 25) (2 + 61) + rank5@32 (2 + 13) = ~78
R=/lustre/fs1/portfolios/coreai/projects/coreai_comparch_trtllm/users/arusli/src/TensorRT-LLM/.wideep-ft-runs/claude
grep -q "^$(hostname -s) " $R/mvp/EXCLUDE_NODES.txt && { echo "EXCLUDED_NODE $(hostname -s)"; exit 1; }
B=build-freeze-1117f7e0e7; MB=build-main-9cc37929e8
SMOKE=${SMOKE:-1}
if [[ $SMOKE == 1 ]]; then
    IT_MAIN=32=6,128=3 IT_HX=8=24,32=6,128=3,512=1 BURN=32:2 KI=3 KI32=8 KSTOP=4 CRR=rank5
else
    IT_MAIN=32=28,128=12 IT_HX=8=39,32=28,128=12,512=4 BURN=32:6 KI=4 KI32=16 KSTOP=8 CRR='rank5 rank5'
fi
SNO=$R/mvp/runs/STD-8193512/autotuner/pinned.json
SON=$R/mvp/runs/STD-G1-8193512/autotuner/pinned.json
SOFF=$R/mvp/runs/STD-8194123/autotuner/pinned.json
HD="TLLM_FAULT_TOLERANCE_HANG_DETECTION=1 TLLM_FAULT_TOLERANCE_HANG_CONFIRM_S=30"
E="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B MAIN_BUILD=$MB WIDEEP_NO_SAMPLERS=1 WIDEEP_POLLUTION_CHECKS=1 WIDEEP_DMON=1 WIDEEP_BURNIN=$BURN STD_PLACEMENT=$R/mvp/runs/STD-8109649/std-offline-placement.yaml $HD FT_COST_E2E_ROUNDS=1 COST_MAX_WAVES=40 COST_CASE_TIMEOUT_S=3000"
MAIN="COST_LOADS=32,128 COST_LOAD_ITERATIONS=$IT_MAIN"
HX="COST_LOADS=8,32,128,512 COST_LOAD_ITERATIONS=$IT_HX"
KS=200
M="--mca btl_tcp_if_include eth0 --mca coll ^hcoll,ucc"
K="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B WIDEEP_MPI_MCA='$M' $HD WIDEEP_FAILURE_DOMAIN=node KF_ITERATIONS=$KI WIDEEP_POLLUTION_CHECKS=1 KF_GRAPH_SIZES=136,148 WIDEEP_KILL_IN_DECODE_STEADY=1 WIDEEP_KILL_AFTER_STEPS=$KS KF_STOP_ITERATIONS=$KSTOP"
KNO="$K KF_BENCH_CONFIG=std-noeplb-ft.yaml KF_VICTIM_RANKS='5 22' KF_VICTIM_NODES='1 5'"
KON="$K KF_BENCH_CONFIG=std-online.yaml KF_VICTIM_RANKS='13 29' KF_VICTIM_NODES='3 7'"
D="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B CR_KEEP_PAGE_CACHE=1 WIDEEP_KILL_AFTER_STEPS=$KS"
A="MVP_BUILD=$B FINAL_BUILD=$B $HD"
run() { echo "bash $R/mvp/harness/run_job.sh $1"; }
SNO=$R/mvp/runs/STD-$SLURM_JOB_ID/autotuner/pinned.json
SON=$R/mvp/runs/STD-G1-$SLURM_JOB_ID/autotuner/pinned.json
P0_1="$KNO KF_ROWS='rank5pf rank0 deadline' KF_REPEATS=$((SMOKE ? 1 : 2)) KF_VICTIM_RANKS=22 KF_VICTIM_NODES=5 $(run KILL-FINAL-OFF-A)"
P0_2="$KNO KF_ROWS='rank5' KF_REPEATS=$((SMOKE ? 1 : 2)) KF_LOAD=32 KF_ITERATIONS=$KI32 $(run KILL-FINAL-OFF-B)"
P0_3="$KON KF_ROWS='rank5 node1 twokill' KF_REPEATS=$((SMOKE ? 1 : 2)) $(run KILL-FINAL-ON)"
G0="{ $P0_1; $P0_2; $P0_3; }"
P8_1="$KON KF_ROWS='stop rank5pf rank5upd rank0 deadline' KF_REPEATS=$((SMOKE ? 1 : 2)) KF_VICTIM_RANKS=29 KF_VICTIM_NODES=7 $(run KILL-FINAL-ON-A)"
P8_2="$KON KF_ROWS='rank5' KF_REPEATS=$((SMOKE ? 1 : 2)) KF_LOAD=32 KF_ITERATIONS=$KI32 $(run KILL-FINAL-ON-B)"
G8="{ $P8_1; $P8_2; }"
if [[ -n ${FIN_GROUP:-} ]]; then
    v=G$FIN_GROUP; [[ -n ${FIN_PART:-} ]] && v=P${FIN_GROUP}_$FIN_PART
    [[ -n ${!v:-} ]] || { echo "DRY_RUN_FAIL no $v in $0"; exit 1; }
    bash -c "${!v}"; exit
fi
bash $R/bundle.sh "0:8:7000:$G0" "8:8:7000:$G8"
